observed_error: RuntimeError: cudnn RNN backward can only be called in training mode
stage: First attempted r4-freezernn step, before any checkpoint was saved
cause: Calling eval() on the frozen recurrent layer prevented cuDNN from storing the activations needed for upstream encoder gradients.
fix: Keep the recurrent module in training mode, set its dropout to 0.0 and requires_grad=False on recurrent parameters.
outcome: The same named 600-step pilot was rerun successfully; final evaluation has 16/405 development edits.
